column1: # Sample WSPR spot list for `cargo run --release -p skipzone-app --bin wspr_validate`.
# Tab-separated: timestamp, TX call, MHz, SNR (2500 Hz reference), TX grid,
# TX power dBm, RX call, RX grid, distance km.
# THESE ROWS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT A CAPTURED DATASET. The geometry, times,
# frequency and power reproduce the 2026-07-24 03:22 UTC 17 m / 200 mW case
# described in the change request (reception confirmed at 406 km and out to
# 13400 km), and the grid squares really are at the stated ranges from the
# transmitter - the harness cross-checks that and would say so otherwise. But
# the callsigns are placeholders and THE SNR COLUMN IS A PLAUSIBLE FILL, NOT A
# MEASUREMENT. Replace this file with a real export before reading anything
# into the error statistics the harness prints; it is here so the harness has
# something structurally valid to run against.
